goals.0: Place names in town: Bahnhof, Apotheke, Post …
goals.3: Words for near and far: hier, dort, in der Nähe, weit
dialog.1.de.4.n: die Nähe = closeness; in der Nähe = nearby
grammar.0.title: Places in town
grammar.0.note: An Apotheke is a pharmacy for medicine — a Drogerie sells general household and care products. Fever and pain medicine is sold only in an Apotheke.
grammar.1.title: in + Dativ: “in …” (where?)
grammar.1.note: The rule from the previous unit: der/das → dem (im), die → der.
grammar.2.title: Near and far
grammar.2.text: hier = here, da/dort = there, in der Nähe = nearby, weit = far. „Gibt es hier eine Apotheke?“ is one of the most useful questions abroad — learn it by heart.
quiz.7.prompt: Put the words in order to make the question: “Is there a pharmacy here?”
